I will think out loud the way I always do when my son asks me about the year.

I am 68 years old. I never went to school. I learned everything from my mother-in-law and from watching the land. 48 years I have worked this soil. My hands know it better than any book.

My land is 10.1 mu. On about 8 mu I do wheat then maize, same as always. The other 2 mu I keep for cotton — my cotton patch is near the house where I can walk out and check the bollworm myself. My husband's back is bad now, so I cannot do much more than this.

**For wheat (the big crop):**
Last year I put one bag of compound fertilizer (the 15-15-15 bag, 50 jin… no, 50 kg bag) on each mu before the plough. Then after the spring green-up, one bag of urea for every two mu. That is what Old Zhao next door does and his wheat always looks good. I will do the same. If I put less, the wheat turns yellow at jointing and I lose yield — better to spend the extra 30 yuan than watch it thin. I water it four times: once before winter so it does not freeze dry, once at green-up, once at jointing, once when the grain is filling. The well is close so this is not hard. I use improved seed from the agricultural station in town — the dealer gives me the same kind every autumn. One spray for the aphid and the yellow rust together. I expect about 450 kg if the spring is not too dry, maybe 500 kg if the rains come right.

**For maize (after wheat):**
When the wheat is cut in June I plant maize straight into the stubble, no ploughing, just the rotary tiller the contractor brings. I buy hybrid seed — the packet from Denghai or whatever the dealer has. I put half a bag of compound fertilizer and half a bag of urea per mu when I sow. Maize in summer gets the rain, so I only water once if July is dry. Two sprays — one for the borer, one if armyworm comes. Neighbors get 550 kg, I usually get the same.

**For cotton (2 mu):**
Cotton is more trouble than it's worth now, but I keep it because I spin a little for the family. I use improved seed, Bt type so the bollworm is less. I put one bag of compound fertilizer per mu and top up with urea when it flowers. I water three times. Pesticide — I spray maybe 6 times through the summer because of aphid and mite and the bollworm that comes even with Bt seed. I plough this plot properly because cotton wants loose soil.

Money is tight. My son sends some, but fertilizer is 130 yuan a bag now, more than before. I do not change what works.
